headline: QUICK SPARK: $5.3B Flows Into ETFs. VOO, SGOV and GLD Lead Investor Demand
summary: VOO led ETF inflows with $3.3B. Investors also poured money into Treasury and gold ETFs; total ETF flows reached $5.3B on Thursday.

headline: SanDisk Jumps 10%, Lululemon Crashes 17%: Stock Market Today
summary: A blowout August jobs report pushed traders to price a coin-flip chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month, dragging the S&P 500 and Dow lower by midday Friday.
